name: Walker Woodworking | Manufacturing Plant
old_description: Since 2000, Walker Woodworking has established a reputation for quality craftsmanship, exceptional service, and a commitment to providing the finest materials, the latest innovations, and the best cabinet designs for your home or business. When you choose our custom cabinets, you have access to a range of options that other cabinet makers cannot offer.
about:
Walker Woodworking was founded in 2000 in Shelby, North Carolina, by Travis Walker, beginning as a hobby and growing into a team of skilled craftsmen building one-of-a-kind cabinets. The company operates a 75,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Shelby.

The shop produces custom cabinets, fine furniture, and luxury cabinetry for residential and commercial spaces. Core processes include custom cabinet manufacturing, CNC routing, extrusion preparation for integrated lighting, and aluminum extrusion machining in silver or black finishes. The facility also handles lighting installation and testing, though it does not warrant third-party electrical work. A service and repair department supports existing installations.

Customers include homeowners, interior designers, and builders across the Southeast. Projects range from kitchen and bath cabinetry to built-in furniture for offices and hospitality venues. The company works with client-supplied extrusion samples and confirms machinability before production.

Walker Woodworking emphasizes in-house production to adapt quickly to design changes and sustainable practices woven through material selection and fabrication. The founder’s original focus on craftsmanship and service remains the basis for the company’s approach to custom millwork.
